name: EdgeNode
description: LAN router providing NTP time and GPS NMEA push to the platform.

name: Apex Local
description: Vendored Apex middleware on localhost (Child v2 :5020). Default SAPIENT target for the UI.

name: BSI Windows
description: Windows BSI Flex 335 v2 reference harness. `port` is the SAPIENT ASM_DA listener (where the UI sends). `admin_port` is the Postgres archive (where the liveness probe targets, because bare-TCP probes to :14005 register as receiver errors in the harness).

name: ui
description: FastAPI UI / template-driven SAPIENT sender. Self-probe; if it's red the UI itself is down (you wouldn't see this drawer).

name: gps
description: NMEA-over-UDP aggregator. Owns UDP/8500 and exposes /gps/current.

name: ntp
description: Multi-source NTP probe. Polls every server in NTP_SERVERS and exposes the voted offset.

name: nodes
description: This service. The unified registry + status aggregator for every named platform resource.

name: apex (REST)
description: Vendored Apex middleware's REST API. Probing the REST surface tells us the container is running and Apex's HTTP layer is up; the SAPIENT-protocol side is observed separately via the apex-local middleware entry.

name: cot-bridge
description: SAPIENT → CoT → TAK fan-out. No HTTP surface; we TCP-probe the SAPIENT inbound port to confirm the container is listening.

name: TAK Server
description: TAK Server CoT ingest on :6969 UDP (where cot-bridge sends). Liveness probe targets :8443 HTTPS admin (mutual TLS, but a TCP-connect is enough to say the server is up). WebTAK lives at /webtak/index.html on the same port.
